Soul Eras

Soul Eras takes you on a journey through Motown, neo-soul & funk with powerhouse vocals, vintage grooves & timeless class—tailored to your event vibe.

About Soul Eras

Soul Eras is a standout soul and Motown band that brings the golden eras of music to life with vintage flair and modern polish. Fronted by Mariam —whose credits include The Brit Awards , Royal Albert Hall , and Wembley —and joined by male vocalist Gershom , who performed at the Royal Wedding of Meghan and Harry , the band’s vocals are second to none. From 60s Motown favourites like “Ain’t No Mountain High Enough” to neo-soul gems like “Cosmic Girl” and “I Need a Dollar” , Soul Eras glide through the decades with effortless style. Their flexible 5 to 8-piece lineup features keys, guitar, bass, drums, sax, trumpet, and up to two lead vocalists, delivering a rich, full sound every time. Whether you’re after a packed dancefloor or a stripped-back acoustic set, they’ve got you covered. With full PA , lighting , and a customisable setlist , Soul Eras promises a spirited, sophisticated, and truly unforgettable live music experience.
